Rhea (AE): CobaltBridge CISO stalled the POC. Blocking asks: 1) BYO-KMS + attestation, 2) named demo SLA (p95), 3) on-prem connector or IP allowlist. They want a firm demo start next Wed. Need exec alignment today. @Oscar @Ben :warning:
Oscar (Solutions): Quick take: Fast path = Dedicated + managed-KMS + IP allowlist (demo in ~3bd). Full BYO-KMS + attestation for Private = ~10-12bd. Suggest phased approach: demo fast, swap to BYO mid-pilot.
Lina (SE): Customer wants p95 < 450ms for short-chat and fallback if SLA breach (auto-switch to quantized model). I'll prepare a minimal runbook and latency test script. Example snippet:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://pilot.cobaltbridge.redwood/health
```
Ben (Eng-Infra): Connector note: containerized agent + mutual-TLS + HSM handshake testing. Engineering ETA ~7-9bd. BYO-KMS adds ~2bd for key exchange tests. If they accept managed-KMS for demo with a hard swap date, we can meet their window.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft BYO-KMS clause + one-page attestation addendum and a mapping for their security questionnaire. Need SOC2 & pen-test links — @Lina drop them here. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Ops: egress peering requires ASN + IPs from customer. Ops owner assigned: Casey.
Rhea (AE): Action items: 1) Oscar one-pager with costs + SLA/fallback (due before sync), 2) Ben confirm connector ETA + infra delta (by 3pm PT), 3) Marta BYO-KMS draft (EOD tomorrow), 4) Lina to post runbook + evidence links. Scheduling 25-min exec sync at 3:30pm PT today. Can everyone join? :calendar:
Oscar (Solutions): Slotting 3:30pm PT. I'll include two fallback model options (int8 quantized + fp16 baseline) and a short cost delta table.
Lina (SE): Will paste runbook and SOC2 link before the call. I'll also prep a quick script to demo fallback switch.
Ben (Eng-Infra): Feasibility spike running now. Will post risks and a connector checklist by 2:45pm PT.
Marta (Legal): ACK. I'll attach an attestation checklist and sample clause.
Rhea (AE): If we can promise a hard swap date for BYO-KMS mid-pilot, CobaltBridge stays green. Keep all updates in-thread; paste meeting notes after sync. :lock:
